note: This file is a configuration-only Python module (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines training hyperparameters for MAE ViT-Large pretraining on ImageNet using MMPretrain/MMEngine. All values are configuration dictionaries and variable assignments.
configure_mae_vit_large_model: configure a MAE ViT-Large model with backbone arch 'l' and decoder embed_dim 1024
configure_amp_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer wrapped with dynamic AMP loss scaling and weight decay 0.05
configure_lr_scheduler: configure a LinearLR warmup for 40 epochs followed by CosineAnnealingLR for 360 epochs
configure_training_runtime: configure an EpochBasedTrainLoop with 400 max epochs and checkpoint every epoch keeping 3 latest
configure_randomness_and_resume: configure training randomness with seed 0 and enable auto resume from checkpoints
